claims.citation: New York Herald, 28 August 1866, p. 9, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Bark "Clara" (Brem), Probst[?], Bremen, 52 days, with
mdse and 183[?] passengers, to Frederick Schwoon. Aug 13,
lat 44, lon 55 50[?], exchanged signals with Br ship Simmons, of
St John, NB; 29th[?], lat 42 56, lon 63 51, schr Tubal Cain. Has
one death on the passage.

claims.citation: The Sun (New York), 28 August 1866, p. 4, col. 3

claims.verbatim:
Bark Clara (Brem.), Probst, Bremen, 52 days, with mdse. and pass.
to Frederick Schwoon. Had one death on the passage. Aug. 13, lat.
44, long. 55 56, exchanged signals with British ship Simmons, of St.
Johns, N. B.; 20th, lat. 42 56, long. 63 51, exchanged signals with Am.
schr. Tubal Cain.
